name: Ifrane
hero_subtitle: Charming mountain town in the heart of the Middle Atlas — cedar forests, scenic lakes, crisp air and the famous stone lion.

info.entry_val: Road from Fes (~1 hr) or Meknes (~1 hr)

overview.title: Crisp mountain air in the Middle Atlas
overview.p1: Ifrane sits above 1,600 meters in the Middle Atlas mountains, built in the 1930s with sloped roofs and European-style chalets. Often called the 'Little Switzerland of Morocco', it features fresh air, cool summers, winter snow, surrounding cedar forests and mountain lakes, all just an hour away from Fes or Meknes.
overview.p2: One day is enough to explore the town center, see the stone lion, and walk near a lake or cedar forest. Stay longer to enjoy mountain hiking or winter skiing at Michlifen. Bringing warm clothing is recommended even in summer.

places.title: Must-visit places in Ifrane
places.subtitle: Mountain lakes, cedar forests, the stone lion and scenic viewpoints.

lion.title: Stone Lion of Ifrane
lion.desc: The famous carved lion in the town center, Ifrane's most photographed symbol.

aoua.title: Dayet Aoua
aoua.desc: Charming tree-lined mountain lake, ideal for walks, picnics and birdwatching.

hachlaf.title: Dayet Hachlaf
hachlaf.desc: A peaceful lake offering relaxing natural surroundings close to Ifrane.

cedar.title: Cedar Forest
cedar.desc: Dense Atlas cedar forests featuring walking trails and the famous Gouraud cedar site.

michlifen.title: Michlifen Station
michlifen.desc: Famous winter ski resort and high viewpoint overlooking the Ifrane mountains.

park.title: Ifrane National Park
park.desc: Protected nature reserve rich in cedar forests and Middle Atlas wildlife.

tizguit.title: Source Tizguit
tizguit.desc: A peaceful water spring and green valley near the town.

vittel.title: Source Vittel
vittel.desc: Well-known spring and popular family picnic spot among green hills.

uni.title: Al Akhawayn University
uni.desc: Prestigious campus with distinctive architecture (exterior visits only).

itinerary.title: Suggested 2-3 day itinerary
itinerary.subtitle: Explore the town and stone lion first, then head towards the lakes and cedar forests.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Visit the stone lion, stroll through the town center, and enjoy a coffee in the crisp air.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Head to Lake Dayet Aoua for walks along the shore, picnics, and birdwatching.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Have dinner in a local restaurant, keeping in mind mountain nights can be chilly.
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Explore walking trails in the cedar forests and visit the historic Gouraud cedar area.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Drive up towards the Michlifen viewpoint or stop to relax at Dayet Hachlaf.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Return to Ifrane for a quiet dinner and relaxation.
detailed_itinerary.day3_md: Visit Source Tizguit or Source Vittel and take a short nature walk among the trees.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ad: Explore the edges of Ifrane National Park or view surroundings near Al Akhawayn University.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ed: Sip a final glass of mint tea before heading toward Fes or Meknes.

1.title: Altitude & Weather
1.desc: The town sits above 1,600 meters, meaning cool nights year-round and potential snow in winter.

2.title: Transport & Driving
2.desc: Renting a car is best to freely explore the lakes, cedar forests, and Michlifen; grand taxis are also available from Fes or Meknes.

3.title: Respect Nature
3.desc: Stick to designated walking trails, avoid leaving litter, and do not disturb wildlife.

daytrips.title: Best day trips from Ifrane
daytrips.subtitle: Lakes, forests, and charming mountain roads toward Azrou and the Middle Atlas.

azrou.title: Azrou
azrou.desc: Charming cedar town about 30 minutes south — famous for forest roads and local Barbary macaques.

fes.title: Fes
fes.desc: About 1 hour by road — the scientific capital and imperial medina.

meknes.title: Meknes
meknes.desc: About 1 hour by road — one of Morocco's historic imperial cities.

timahdite.title: Timahdite area
timahdite.desc: High plateaus and scenic Middle Atlas rural landscapes south of Ifrane.

q1.question: How many days in Ifrane?
q1.answer: One full day is enough to explore the town center and main landmarks; 2 to 3 days give you time for mountain hiking, lakes, and cedar forests.

q2.question: Is the weather cold in Ifrane?
q2.answer: Yes, Ifrane is much colder than neighboring cities year-round, featuring pleasant mild summers and cold, snowy winters.

q3.question: Do I need a car to visit Ifrane?
q3.answer: Renting a car is highly recommended to easily move between the lakes, cedar forests, and Michlifen station.

q4.question: Can you ski in Ifrane?
q4.answer: Michlifen station offers skiing opportunities and winter equipment during snowy winter periods (typically December to March).

q5.question: How far is Ifrane from Fes?
q5.answer: Ifrane is about a 1-hour drive from Fes.
